text:
The Tiki Totem was introduced in Desktop 1.2. The wiki's Tiki Totem page lists "Desktop 1.2: Introduced" in its History section, which my earlier lookups missed because I checked the Tiki page and the version history page instead. The shared note's reasoning about 1.2 adding Tiki-themed furniture is unsourced, and the version history page doesn't mention Tiki at all, so I'm relying only on the Tiki Totem page for this answer.

CONFIDENCE: 75

- https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki_Totem
